q: भारत के सर्वोच्च साहित्यिक सम्मान 60वें ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार से किसे सम्मानित किया गया?
e:
Noted Tamil poet and lyricist R. Vairamuthu was selected for the 60th Jnanpith Award (60वाँ ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार आर. वैरामुत्तु को प्रदान किया गया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Mamta Kalia won the Sahitya Akademi Award 2025 in Hindi ('Jeete Jee Allahabad') and Navtej Sarna won it in English.
2. The 58th Jnanpith Award (2023) was jointly awarded to Gulzar (Urdu) and Jagadguru Rambhadracharya (Sanskrit).
3. Jnanpith Award carries a cash prize of ₹11 lakh, a citation, and a bronze replica of Vagdevi (Saraswati).
qe: Who was honoured with the 60th Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary recognition?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में, 2026 एशियाई खेलों में किस भारतीय पहलवान ने 57 किग्रा वर्ग में स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
e:
Aman Sehrawat won the 57 kg wrestling gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games in October 2026, while Sujeet Kalkal won 65 kg wrestling gold (अमन सहरावत ने 57 किग्रा कुश्ती में स्वर्ण पदक जीता)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. In October 2026 boxing at the Asian Games, Lovlina Borgohain (75 kg), Parveen Hooda (65 kg), and Ankush Panghal (80 kg) won golds.
2. Pranavi Urs won Women's Individual Golf Gold on 3 October 2026.
3. India also won team golds in Cricket, Hockey, and Archery at the 2026 Asian Games.
qe: In October 2026, which Indian wrestler won the 57 kg Gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा नगर ताजमहल, आगरा किला और निकटवर्ती फतेहपुर सीकरी—तीनों यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थलों—के लिए विश्व प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Agra (on the Yamuna river) hosts all three UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Uttar Pradesh: Taj Mahal (1983), Agra Fort (1983), and Fatehpur Sikri (1986) (आगरा में उत्तर प्रदेश के तीनों यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Agra also hosts Nur Jahan Sarai (highlighted in 2026 heritage conservation news) and Itimad-ud-Daulah's Tomb.
2. The famous Taj Mahotsav is organized annually in February at Shilpgram, Agra.
3. Bateshwar Fair (cattle fair) is held in Agra district on the Yamuna river.
qe: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is world-famous for the Taj Mahal, Agra Fort, and nearby Fatehpur Sikri—all three UNESCO World Heritage Sites?

q: 'एक जिला एक उत्पाद' (ODOP) पहल के अंतर्गत उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला 'पीतल नगरी' (Brass City) के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Moradabad (on the Ramganga river) is world-famous for brass handicrafts and metalwork ('Peetal Nagari') (मुरादाबाद को पीतल नगरी कहा जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Firozabad = Glass Bangles; Aligarh = Locks; Saharanpur = Wood Carving; Bhadohi = Carpets.
2. Meerut = Sports Goods; Kannauj = Perfume (Itra); Varanasi = Banarasi Silk.
3. UP's ODOP scheme was launched on 24 January 2018.
qe: Which district of Uttar Pradesh is renowned as 'Peetal Nagari' (Brass City) under the One District One Product (ODOP) initiative?

q: स्वतंत्र भारत के प्रथम भारतीय गवर्नर-जनरल (1948–1950) कौन थे?
e:
Chakravarti Rajagopalachari ('Rajaji') was the first and only Indian Governor-General of independent India (June 1948 to January 1950), succeeding Lord Mountbatten (सी. राजगोपालाचारी स्वतंत्र भारत के प्रथम भारतीय गवर्नर-जनरल थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. C. Rajagopalachari was among the first three recipients of the Bharat Ratna in 1954 (alongside Dr. S. Radhakrishnan and Sir C. V. Raman).
2. He later founded the Swatantra Party in 1959.
3. Dr. Rajendra Prasad became the first President of the Republic of India on 26 January 1950.
qe: Who was the first Indian Governor-General of Independent India (1948–1950)?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 29 और 30 के अंतर्गत कौन-सा मौलिक अधिकार अल्पसंख्यकों की लिपि, भाषा, संस्कृति और शिक्षण संस्थाओं की रक्षा करता है?
e:
Articles 29 and 30 guarantee Cultural and Educational Rights, empowering linguistic and religious minorities to conserve their language/culture and establish & administer educational institutions (अनुच्छेद 29–30 संस्कृति एवं शिक्षा संबंधी अधिकार हैं)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Article 29 protects ANY section of citizens having a distinct language, script, or culture.
2. Article 30 grants minorities (religious or linguistic) the right to establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
3. Both Articles 29 and 30 are available exclusively to citizens of India.
qe: Which Fundamental Right under Articles 29 and 30 of the Indian Constitution protects the script, language, culture, and educational institutions of minorities?

q: भारत में बहने वाली सबसे लंबी नदी कौन-सी है जो ब्रह्मपुत्र के साथ मिलकर विश्व का सबसे बड़ा डेल्टा (सुंदरबन) बनाती है?
e:
The Ganga (2,525 km) is India's National River (declared in 2008) and combines with the Brahmaputra (Jamuna) in Bangladesh to form the Sundarbans delta (गंगा भारत की सबसे लंबी व राष्ट्रीय नदी है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Yamuna (1,376 km, rising from Yamunotri Glacier) is the longest tributary of the Ganga, meeting it at Prayagraj.
2. Namami Gange Programme was launched in June 2014 for abatement of pollution and rejuvenation of the Ganga.
3. Gangetic River Dolphin (Platanista gangetica) is India's National Aquatic Animal (declared 2009).
qe: Which river is the longest river flowing entirely within India and forms the world's largest delta (Sundarbans) along with the Brahmaputra?

q: किसी देश की घरेलू सीमा के भीतर एक वर्ष में उत्पादित सभी अंतिम वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के कुल मौद्रिक मूल्य को मापने वाले 'GDP' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e:
GDP stands for Gross Domestic Product—the primary indicator of domestic economic output (GDP का पूर्ण रूप सकल घरेलू उत्पाद है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. GNP (Gross National Product) = GDP + Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA).
2. India's financial year runs from 1 April to 31 March.
3. Base year for India's national accounts series has been 2011–12 (with periodic revisions overseen by MoSPI).
qe: What is the full form of 'GDP' used worldwide to measure the total monetary value of all final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory in a year?

q: सेल्सियस और फारेनहाइट पैमाने पर मानव शरीर का सामान्य तापमान क्रमशः कितना होता है?
e:
Normal human core body temperature is 37°C = 98.6°F = 310.15 K (मानव शरीर का सामान्य तापमान 37°C या 98.6°F होता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Conversion formula: F = (9/5)C + 32. Notice -40°C = -40°F (the unique temperature where both scales coincide).
2. The Hypothalamus in the human brain acts as the body's thermostat (thermoregulation centre).
3. Clinical thermometers use Mercury (liquid metal with uniform thermal expansion) or digital thermistors.
qe: What is the normal human body temperature on the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales respectively?

q: 2026 में शिक्षा मंत्रालय ने मराठी, पालि, प्राकृत, असमिया और बांग्ला को किस विशेष श्रेणी में मान्यता मिलने के बाद उनके लिए 5 उत्कृष्टता केंद्र (CoEs) स्थापित किए?
e:
These 5 languages were accorded Classical Language status in October 2024, taking India's total to 11 Classical Languages, for which MoE set up 5 dedicated CoEs (इन्हें भारत की शास्त्रीय भाषा का दर्जा मिला)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. The earlier 6 Classical Languages were Tamil, Sanskrit, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, and Odia.
2. Classical status brings national awards for scholars, university chairs, and dedicated Centres of Excellence.
3. Marathi is the 3rd most spoken language in India (after Hindi and Bengali, per Census 2011).
qe: In 2026, the Ministry of Education established 5 Centres of Excellence (CoEs) for Marathi, Pali, Prakrit, Assamese, and Bengali following their recognition under which special category?

q: अक्टूबर 2026 में पेप्ट्रिस ने AI-आधारित औषधि खोज के लिए ₹86 करोड़ का सहयोग प्राप्त किया, जबकि ICAR-IIAB ने किस शहर में नई कृषि जैव प्रौद्योगिकी सुविधाओं का उद्घाटन किया?
e:
ICAR–Indian Institute of Agricultural Biotechnology (ICAR-IIAB) is situated in Ranchi, Jharkhand, where new facilities were inaugurated in October 2026 (ICAR-IIAB राँची में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. India signed a ₹661.50 crore contract in Oct 2026 for the Indian Navy's BrahMos system.
2. India and France also signed a bilateral MoU in 2026 for manuscript conservation and digitization.
3. Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) is headed by the Union Minister of Agriculture as President.
qe: In October 2026, Peptris secured ₹86 crore support for AI-Based Drug Discovery, while ICAR-IIAB inaugurated new agricultural biotechnology facilities in which city?

q: नवंबर 2026 में चर्चित कौन-सी पारंपरिक जल संचयन प्रणाली केरल (लैटेराइट पहाड़ियों में खोदी गई क्षैतिज सुरंगें) से संबंधित है?
e:
Surangam (or Suranga) is a traditional subterranean tunnel-well system of northern Kerala (Kasaragod) and coastal Karnataka (सुरंगम केरल की पारंपरिक जल संचयन प्रणाली है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Eri = Tamil Nadu; Khadin = Rajasthan; Bamboo Drip Irrigation = Meghalaya; Zing = Ladakh.
2. National Water Mission is one of the 8 missions under India's National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC).
3. World Water Day is celebrated on 22 March every year.
qe: In November 2026, which traditional water harvesting system was highlighted as belonging to Kerala (horizontal tunnel wells cut into laterite hillocks)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश का कौन-सा जिला मुंशी प्रेमचन्द (लमही गाँव) और भारतेन्दु हरिश्चन्द्र की जन्मभूमि के रूप में प्रसिद्ध है तथा जहाँ काशी नागरी प्रचारिणी सभा (1893) स्थित है?
e:
Both Munshi Premchand (Lamhi village) and Bharatendu Harishchandra were born in Varanasi, which also hosts the historic Nagari Pracharini Sabha (1893) and BHU (वाराणसी प्रेमचन्द व भारतेन्दु की जन्मभूमि है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Prayagraj (Allahabad) was the karmabhoomi of Nirala, Mahadevi Verma, Sumitranandan Pant, and Harivansh Rai Bachchan, and hosted the Hindi Sahitya Sammelan (1910).
2. UP Budget 2026–27 (10th full budget) sets a per capita income target of ₹1,20,000 and 10 lakh youth jobs.
3. Pooja Pal of Barabanki (UP) received the INSPIRE Award in 2026.
qe: Which Uttar Pradesh district is famous as the birthplace of Munshi Premchand (Lamhi village) and Bharatendu Harishchandra, and houses the Kashi Nagari Pracharini Sabha (1893)?

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के लखीमपुर खीरी जिले में भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर स्थित कौन-सा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान/टाइगर रिजर्व बारहसिंगा और एक सींग वाले गैंडे के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e:
Dudhwa National Park (Lakhimpur Kheri, established 1977, declared Tiger Reserve in 1987–88) is UP's only National Park and a key sanctuary for Barasingha and reintroduced rhinos (दुधवा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान लखीमपुर खीरी में स्थित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. UP has 4 Tiger Reserves: Dudhwa, Pilibhit, Amangarh (Bijnor), and Ranipur (Chitrakoot — India's 53rd Tiger Reserve).
2. Billy Arjan Singh was the renowned wildlife conservationist associated with Dudhwa.
3. UP's State Animal is Barasingha (Swamp Deer).
qe: Which national park/tiger reserve in Uttar Pradesh lies along the Indo-Nepal border in Lakhimpur Kheri district and is famous for Swamp Deer (Barasingha) and One-Horned Rhinos?

q: प्रसिद्ध अंग्रेजी लेखक जॉर्ज ऑरवेल का जन्म 1903 में बिहार के मोतिहारी में हुआ था; उस समय भारत के वायसराय (1899–1905) कौन थे?
e:
Lord Curzon served as Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905 (passing the Ancient Monuments Preservation Act 1904, Indian Universities Act 1904, and executing the Partition of Bengal 1905)—during which Eric Arthur Blair (George Orwell) was born in Motihari in 1903 (1903 में लॉर्ड कर्जन भारत के वायसराय थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Rudyard Kipling ('The Jungle Book', 1907 Nobel Laureate) was also born in India (Bombay, 1865).
2. William Makepeace Thackeray ('Vanity Fair') was born in Calcutta (1811).
3. Lord Curzon established the Archaeological Survey of India on a permanent footing under Sir John Marshall in 1902.
qe: Which English poet-novelist's birthplace in Bihar (Motihari, 1903) links India directly to 20th-century British political literature, and during whose Viceroyalty (1899–1905) was he born?

q: प्रसिद्ध 'काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन' (9 अगस्त 1925, लखनऊ के निकट) किस क्रांतिकारी संगठन के सदस्यों द्वारा अंजाम दिया गया था?
e:
HRA revolutionaries—Ram Prasad Bismil, Ashfaqulla Khan, Rajendra Lahiri, Roshan Singh, and Chandra Shekhar Azad—executed the Kakori Train Action on 9 August 1925 (HRA ने काकोरी ट्रेन एक्शन किया)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Martyrs hanged in the Kakori case (Dec 1927): Ram Prasad Bismil (Gorakhpur Jail), Ashfaqulla Khan (Faizabad Jail), Roshan Singh (Naini Jail, Prayagraj), and Rajendra Lahiri (Gonda Jail).
2. Chandra Shekhar Azad evaded arrest and later reorganized HRA into HSRA (1928) before attaining martyrdom at Alfred Park, Allahabad (27 Feb 1931).
3. UP Government renamed the 'Kakori Train Conspiracy' as 'Kakori Train Action' in August 2021.
qe: The famous 'Kakori Train Action' (9 August 1925, near Lucknow) was executed by revolutionaries of which organization?

q: डॉ. ए. लक्ष्मणस्वामी मुदालियर की अध्यक्षता में किस आयोग (1952–53) ने भारत में माध्यमिक शिक्षा की समीक्षा की और बहुउद्देशीय विद्यालयों की सिफारिश की?
e:
The Secondary Education Commission (Mudaliar Commission, 1952–53) was independent India's landmark panel on secondary schooling (मुदालियर आयोग माध्यमिक शिक्षा आयोग था)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Radhakrishnan Commission (1948–49) = University Education Commission (recommended UGC).
2. Kothari Commission (1964–66) = comprehensive Education Commission (10+2+3 pattern, 6% GDP spend).
3. Sam Pitroda chaired the National Knowledge Commission (2005–09).
qe: Which Commission (1952–53), chaired by Dr. A. Lakshmanaswami Mudaliar, specifically examined Secondary Education in India and recommended multipurpose schools and the 3-year secondary + 4-year higher secondary pattern?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 85 के अंतर्गत संसद के दो क्रमिक सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम अनुमन्य अंतराल कितना हो सकता है?
e:
Article 85(1) mandates that six months shall not intervene between the last sitting of one session and the first sitting of the next session, meaning Parliament must meet at least twice a year (दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम अंतराल 6 माह हो सकता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. By convention, India's Parliament holds three sessions annually: Budget Session (Feb–May, longest), Monsoon Session (July–Sept), and Winter Session (Nov–Dec, shortest).
2. Prorogation (सत्रावसान) terminates a session (done by the President), whereas Adjournment (स्थगन) suspends a sitting temporarily (done by the Presiding Officer).
3. Dissolution (विघटन) applies ONLY to the Lok Sabha, never to the Rajya Sabha.
qe: In the Indian Parliament, what is the maximum permissible gap between two consecutive sessions of Parliament under Article 85?

q: भारत की निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी पर्वत श्रेणी नर्मदा और तापी भ्रंश घाटियों के बीच स्थित एक आदर्श 'ब्लॉक पर्वत' (भ्रंशोत्थ पर्वत) है?
e:
Satpura Range (extending across Gujarat, Maharashtra, MP, Chhattisgarh; highest peak Dhupgarh at 1,350 m) is a classic Horst / Block Mountain flanked by Narmada (north) and Tapi (south) (सतपुड़ा एक ब्लॉक पर्वत है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Aravalli is an old relict fold mountain; Himalayas are young fold mountains.
2. Pachmarhi ('Queen of Satpura') is a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in Madhya Pradesh.
3. Vindhya Range acts as the traditional geographical divide between North India and Peninsular South India.
qe: Which of the following mountain ranges in India is a classic 'Block Mountain' (Horst) lying between the Narmada and Tapi rift valleys?

q: जब किसी कार्य (विशेषतः भारतीय कृषि) में आवश्यकता से अधिक श्रमिक लगे हों और अतिरिक्त श्रमिकों की सीमांत उत्पादकता शून्य हो, तो उस बेरोजगारी को क्या कहते हैं?
e:
Disguised (hidden) unemployment has zero marginal productivity—removing surplus labour does not reduce total output (प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी में सीमांत उत्पादकता शून्य होती है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Frictional unemployment is temporary unemployment while switching jobs.
2. Structural unemployment arises from a mismatch between workers' skills and available jobs.
3. Cyclical unemployment occurs during economic recessions/downturns.
qe: Which type of unemployment occurs when more workers are employed in an activity (especially Indian agriculture) than are actually required, so that the marginal productivity of extra workers is zero?

q: भारत सरकार द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया कौन-सा डिजिटल मंच क्लाउड-आधारित प्रामाणिक दस्तावेज वॉलेट के रूप में ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस, अंकपत्र और डिग्रियों की वैध डिजिटल प्रतियाँ प्रदान करता है?
e:
DigiLocker (under Digital India, MeitY) issues and stores authentic e-documents directly from issuers (CBSE, universities, RTOs) with legal equivalence under the IT Rules, 2016 (डिजिलॉकर प्रामाणिक डिजिटल दस्तावेज वॉलेट है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Bhashini is India's National Language Translation Mission using AI to provide voice/text services in Indian languages.
2. NAD (National Academic Depository) and ABC (Academic Bank of Credits) are integrated with DigiLocker.
3. UPI (Unified Payments Interface) is operated by NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India).
qe: Which Indian digital platform launched by the Government of India serves as a cloud-based authentic document wallet providing legally valid digital copies of driving licences, marksheets, and degrees?

q:
2026 की भारतीय वैज्ञानिक एवं नवाचार उपलब्धियों के संदर्भ में निम्नलिखित दो कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
कथन I: भारत का 51वाँ डॉप्लर वेदर रडार (DWR) गंभीर मौसम पूर्वानुमान हेतु भारतीय मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) के अधीन संचालित है।
कथन II: बाराबंकी (उत्तर प्रदेश) की पूजा पाल ने 2026 में INSPIRE पुरस्कार जीता।
उपर्युक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
o: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II
e:
Both statements are verified 2026 facts (दोनों कथन सत्य हैं): IMD operates the 51st Doppler Weather Radar, and Pooja Pal of Barabanki received the INSPIRE Award.
Exam Booster Facts:
1. IMD functions under the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES).
2. INSPIRE–MANAK (Million Minds Augmenting National Aspirations and Knowledge) nurtures young innovators from Classes 6–10.
3. National Innovation Foundation (NIF) is headquartered in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
qe:
Consider the following two statements regarding 2026 Indian sports and scientific milestones:
Statement I: India's 51st Doppler Weather Radar (DWR) operates under the India Meteorological Department (IMD) to enhance severe weather forecasting.
Statement II: Pooja Pal from Barabanki (Uttar Pradesh) won the INSPIRE Award in 2026.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
oe: Both Statement I and Statement II
Neither Statement I nor Statement II

q: उत्तर प्रदेश के एक्सप्रेस-वे और उनके अंतिम सिरों (terminals) का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
o: Yamuna Expressway — Greater Noida to Agra
e:
The 594 km Ganga Expressway connects MEERUT to PRAYAGRAJ (passing through 12 districts), NOT Ghaziabad to Varanasi (गंगा एक्सप्रेस-वे मेरठ को प्रयागराज से जोड़ता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Yamuna Expressway (165 km, opened 2012) links Greater Noida to Agra.
2. Agra–Lucknow Expressway (302 km) and Purvanchal Expressway (341 km, Lucknow to Ghazipur) both feature emergency fighter-jet landing strips.
3. Gorakhpur Link Expressway connects Gorakhpur directly to the Purvanchal Expressway in Azamgarh.
qe: Which of the following pairs of Uttar Pradesh Expressways and their terminal endpoints is NOT correctly matched?
oe: Yamuna Expressway — Greater Noida to Agra

q: भारतीय स्वतंत्रता अधिनियम (जुलाई 1947) के समय ब्रिटेन के प्रधानमंत्री कौन थे, जो पूर्व में साइमन कमीशन (1927) के सदस्य भी रहे थे?
e:
Labour Prime Minister Clement Attlee (1945–51) sent the Cabinet Mission (1946), made the historic 20 February 1947 announcement, and oversaw the Indian Independence Act, 1947; he had earlier served on the 7-member Simon Commission (क्लेमेंट एटली 1947 में ब्रिटेन के प्रधानमंत्री थे)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Ramsay MacDonald announced the Communal Award (16 August 1932) during the Round Table Conferences.
2. Winston Churchill was PM during World War II (Cripps Mission 1942 & Quit India Movement).
3. Lord Mountbatten was the last Viceroy of British India and first Governor-General of Independent India.
qe: Who was the British Prime Minister at the time of the Indian Independence Act (July 1947), who had earlier served as a member of the Simon Commission (1927)?

q: 1478 ई. में जन्मे किस मध्यकालीन भक्ति संत-कवि ने वल्लभाचार्य के मार्गदर्शन में ब्रजभाषा में 'सूरसागर', 'सूरसारावली' और 'साहित्य लहरी' की रचना की?
e:
Mahakavi Surdas (chief poet of Ashtachhap, born at Sihi / Runkata) composed 'Sur Sagar' in Brajbhasha depicting Krishna's Vatsalya and Madhurya leelas (सूरदास ने सूरसागर, सूरसारावली व साहित्य लहरी रची)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Goswami Tulsidas (1532–1623, contemporary of Akbar) wrote Ramcharitmanas (1574 CE, Awadhi).
2. Vallabhacharya propounded Shuddhadvaita and Pushtimarg.
3. Surdas was called the 'Ship of Pushtimarg' (पुष्टिमार्ग का जहाज) by Vitthalnath.
qe: Which medieval Bhakti poet-saint—born in 1478 CE and blind from birth/early age—authored 'Sur Sagar', 'Sur Saravali', and 'Sahitya Lahari' in Brajbhasha under the guidance of Vallabhacharya?

q: भारतीय संविधान के अंतर्गत 'दल-बदल विरोधी कानून' (दसवीं अनुसूची) निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थिति में लागू नहीं होता है?
o: An independent elected MP joins a political party after taking oath
A nominated MP joins a political party after 8 months of taking seat
Two-thirds of the legislators of a political party agree to merge with another party
An MP votes contrary to the party whip without prior permission
e:
Paragraph 4 of the Tenth Schedule exempts a valid MERGER if at least two-thirds (2/3) of the members of a legislature party agree to merge with another party; all other options (A, B, D) trigger disqualification (दो-तिहाई सदस्यों के विलय पर अयोग्यता लागू नहीं होती)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. A nominated member may join a political party ONLY within 6 months of taking their seat (joining after 6 months causes disqualification).
2. An independent member cannot join ANY political party at any time after election without losing membership.
3. The 91st Amendment Act (2003) abolished the earlier 1/3rd 'split' protection.
qe: Under the Constitution of India, the 'Anti-Defection Law' (Tenth Schedule) does NOT apply to which of the following situations?
oe: An independent elected MP joins a political party after taking oath
A nominated MP joins a political party after 8 months of taking seat
Two-thirds of the legislators of a political party agree to merge with another party
An MP votes contrary to the party whip without prior permission

q: भारतीय संविधान का कौन-सा अनुच्छेद 'भारत की आकस्मिकता निधि' (Contingency Fund of India) से संबंधित है, जो संसदीय स्वीकृति की प्रतीक्षा में अप्रत्याशित व्यय हेतु राष्ट्रपति के अधीन रहती है?
e:
Article 267 establishes the Contingency Fund of India (statutory corpus currently ₹30,000 crore, operated by the Finance Secretary on behalf of the President) (अनुच्छेद 267 भारत की आकस्मिकता निधि से संबंधित है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Article 266(1) establishes the Consolidated Fund of India (no money can be withdrawn without an Appropriation Act passed by Parliament).
2. Article 266(2) establishes the Public Account of India (provident funds, small savings — operated by executive action).
3. Article 112 mandates laying the Annual Financial Statement (Union Budget) before Parliament.
qe: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the 'Contingency Fund of India' (placed at the disposal of the President for unforeseen urgent expenditure pending parliamentary authorization)?

q: भारतीय नदियों और उनके उद्गम स्थलों का निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा युग्म सही सुमेलित नहीं है?
e:
Kaveri originates at Talakaveri in the Brahmagiri Hills of Kodagu (Karnataka), whereas Trimbakeshwar (Nashik, Maharashtra) is the source of the GODAVARI river (कावेरी का उद्गम ब्रह्मगिरि पहाड़ियों, कर्नाटक से होता है; त्र्यंबकेश्वर गोदावरी का उद्गम है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Tapi originates at Multai in Betul district (MP); Son originates near Amarkantak (MP) and flows north to join the Ganga near Patna.
2. Indus, Sutlej, and Brahmaputra all originate in Tibet near Lake Mansarovar / Mount Kailash.
3. Chambal originates from Janapav Hills (Vindhya Range, MP) and joins Yamuna near Etawah (UP).
qe: Which of the following pairs of Indian Rivers and their Origins is NOT correctly matched?

q: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अर्थशास्त्र में 1969 में सृजित 'विशेष आहरण अधिकार' (SDR — जिसे प्रायः 'पेपर गोल्ड' कहा जाता है) क्या है?
o: A supplementary international reserve asset created by the IMF based on a basket of five major currencies
A gold-backed sovereign bond issued by the World Bank
A tariff-free trade quota issued by the WTO
A cryptocurrency issued by the Bank for International Settlements
e:
SDR is an international reserve asset created by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) whose value is based on a basket of 5 currencies: US Dollar, Euro, Chinese Renminbi (Yuan), Japanese Yen, and British Pound Sterling (SDR, IMF द्वारा 5 प्रमुख मुद्राओं की टोकरी पर आधारित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय आरक्षित परिसंपत्ति है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Chinese Renminbi (Yuan) was added as the 5th currency in the IMF SDR basket in October 2016.
2. IMF publishes the 'World Economic Outlook' (WEO) and 'Global Financial Stability Report'.
3. World Bank publishes the 'World Development Report' and 'Global Economic Prospects'.
qe: In international economics, what is 'Special Drawing Rights' (SDR) — often nicknamed 'Paper Gold' — created in 1969?
oe: A supplementary international reserve asset created by the IMF based on a basket of five major currencies
A gold-backed sovereign bond issued by the World Bank
A tariff-free trade quota issued by the WTO
A cryptocurrency issued by the Bank for International Settlements

q: मानव जठर रस (आमाशय) में कौन-सा अम्ल प्राकृतिक रूप से उपस्थित होता है जो रोगाणुओं को नष्ट करता है और पेप्सिनोजेन को पेप्सिन में सक्रिय करने हेतु अम्लीय pH (~1.5–2.0) बनाता है?
e:
Parietal (oxyntic) cells of the stomach mucosa secrete Hydrochloric Acid (HCl) and Intrinsic Factor (for Vitamin B12 absorption), while a thick mucus layer protects the stomach wall from self-digestion (जठर रस में हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल — HCl — पाया जाता है)।
Exam Booster Facts:
1. Antacids like Milk of Magnesia [Mg(OH)₂] neutralize excess stomach HCl in acidity.
2. Natural organic acids: Lemon/Orange — Citric acid; Tamarind/Grapes — Tartaric acid; Vinegar — Acetic acid; Ant sting — Formic (Methanoic) acid; Sour milk/Curd — Lactic acid.
3. pH scale (0–14, invented by S. P. L. Sørensen): <7 acidic, 7 neutral, >7 alkaline/basic.
qe: Which acid is naturally present in human gastric juice (stomach) to kill ingested microbes and create the acidic pH (~1.5–2.0) required to activate pepsinogen into pepsin?
